review_summary: Comprehensive Review (Chidzidzo 14) consolidates Lessons 8, 9, 10, 11, 12, 13. Key structures mastered in this block include Zezuru alliterative subject/object concords (zvivakashure), agglutinative tense/aspect markers (-no- habitual, -ka- past, -cha- future), and high/low tone patterns across: Mupanda 9 (i-/dzi-) Mass Noun; Mupanda 5/9 Nominal or Verbal Stem; Mupanda 9 (i-) Past Concord (yaka-); Mupanda 16 Locative Prefix (pa-). Example utterances reviewed: "Nyama iyi yakaoma chaizvo pakubikwa kwayo." | "Kwedu kune makomo marefu anonakidza kuona." | "Ugosvika pano manhero kuti tigozodya tese."

review_exercises.prompt: Complete the Zezuru sentence: 'Nyama iyi yakaoma chaizvo pakubikwa ______.' (This meat became very tough when it was cooked.)
review_exercises.explanation: 'kwayo' completes the clause with the proper Zezuru lexical and tonal pattern.

review_exercises.prompt: Complete the Zezuru sentence: 'Kwedu kune makomo marefu anonakidza ______.' (At our home region there are tall mountains that are lovely to see.)
review_exercises.explanation: 'kuona' completes the clause with the proper Zezuru lexical and tonal pattern.

review_exercises.prompt: Complete the Zezuru sentence: 'Ugosvika pano manhero kuti tigozodya ______.' (Be sure to arrive here in the evening so that we can eat together.)
review_exercises.explanation: 'tese' completes the clause with the proper Zezuru lexical and tonal pattern.

review_exercises.prompt: Complete the Zezuru sentence: 'Ndeipi mota yaunoda kutenga, tsvuku kana ______?' (Which car do you want to buy, the red one or the black one?)
review_exercises.explanation: 'nhema' completes the clause with the proper Zezuru lexical and tonal pattern.

review_exercises.prompt: Complete the Zezuru sentence: 'Mvura iri kunaya zvakanyanya kunze uko ______.' (It is raining heavily outside there today.)
review_exercises.explanation: 'nhasi' completes the clause with the proper Zezuru lexical and tonal pattern.

review_exercises.prompt: Complete the Zezuru sentence: 'Imbwa iri kuhukura panze pamwe pane ______.' (The dog is barking outside; perhaps there is something it has seen.)
review_exercises.explanation: 'chayaoona' completes the clause with the proper Zezuru lexical and tonal pattern.
